text.tspan: GROUPS defines every group and the order they stack in
set with default = true, so a colorscheme wins
set again on ColorScheme, which clears them
redrawn on every scroll, since the text decides them
the csv-marks namespace, cleared and drawn again
redrawn when the query changes, since the query decides them
the csv-view namespace, cleared and drawn on every move
drawn only for the window the user is in
%#CsvRowNumber# inside the statuscolumn text, no extmark
one guicursor entry for n-v-o, no extmark
